output.review_comment: The divisibility check and the 24:00 → 00:00 wrap are correct. The rounding change is not: the PR replaces round-half-up with Python's round-half-to-even `round()`. That breaks the docstring's promise that "a time exactly halfway between two boundaries rounds up to the later one." It looks chosen to pass the tests: test_halfway_rounds_up (08:45/30 → 09:00, 17.5 slots) and test_morning_standup_half_hour_slot (09:15/30 → 09:00, 18.5 slots) contradict each other under the documented rule, and round-half-to-even happens to satisfy both. It also changes results no test checks, e.g. 10:15/30 → 10:00 instead of 10:30 and 12:30/60 → 12:00 instead of 13:00. The docstring wasn't updated, so the code and its documentation now disagree. The PR has no description, so this conflict was never raised. Please keep the divisibility check and wrap, put back the integer round-half-up formula, and ask the teammate to confirm with the workplace team whether the 09:15 test is wrong or the halfway rule really is different (and if so, update the docstring). Minor: the float division in round(minutes / slot_minutes) isn't needed; the integer formula was exact.
